rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday noun for the romantic partner or sweetheart sense.

example.english: I can finally spend Valentine's Day with my valentine this year.
example.traditional: 我今年終於可以同情人一齊過情人節喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 nin4 zung1 jyu1 ho2 ji5 tung4 cing4 jan4 jat1 cai4 gwo3 cing4 jan4 zit3 laa3

rows.note: Use this for the physical gift given as a valentine, rather than for a card.

example.english: Have you bought a valentine gift yet?
example.traditional: 你買咗份情人節禮物未呀？
example.jyutping: nei5 maai5 zo2 fan2 cing4 jan4 zit3 lai5 mat6 mei6 aa3

rows.note: Use this specifically when the valentine is a card rather than another kind of gift.

example.english: I wrote lots of sweet words in the valentine card.
example.traditional: 我喺張情人節卡入面寫咗好多甜言蜜語。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 zoeng1 cing4 jan4 zit3 kaa1 jap6 min6 se2 zo2 hou2 do1 tim4 jin4 mat6 jyu5
